footer.about: OmniStore is an app store experience for open-source software. Metadata, trust, security, search and recommendations are served by OmniSource Pro.
footer.sourcesNote: OmniSource indexes releases directly from these upstreams — OmniStore never mirrors binaries.

about.title: About OmniStore
about.intro: OmniStore is the storefront; OmniSource Pro is the engine. One source of truth, no duplicated metadata.
about.architectureBody: OmniStore clients (web, iOS, Android, desktop) consume a single REST contract from OmniSource Pro: apps, search, collections, recommendations, trust and security. There is no local catalog, no duplicated search index and no client-side scoring anywhere in OmniStore.
about.sourcesBody: OmniSource indexes GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg, Forgejo, F-Droid, Flathub, Winget and Homebrew. Apps are discovered, enriched, validated and scored upstream; OmniStore renders the result.
about.trustBody: Trust scores, badges and security evidence are computed inside OmniSource from public signals — release consistency, contributor diversity, asset validation, scanner findings — and are always displayed with their factors.
about.honestyBody: Nothing is invented. Missing upstream data renders as “Not available”. Only validated packages are offered as downloads. Verification is not a malware guarantee, and OmniStore never claims it is.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body1: OmniStore stores no advertising identifiers and runs no third-party trackers.
privacy.body2: Your favorites, bookmarks and collections live in your browser (IndexedDB). If you sign in to sync, the store attaches your library to a one-way derivation of your email — never the email itself — via the OmniSource favorites API.
privacy.body3: Opt-in, count-only analytics may record that an event happened, but never who it happened for.
privacy.body4: Outbound links use the referrer-policy strict-origin-when-cross-origin.

terms.title: Terms
terms.body1: OmniStore presents metadata about open-source projects. Downloads continue on the upstream release host; OmniStore does not mirror or repackage binaries.
terms.body2: Trust and security information is informational and provided as-is. It is not a warranty or a malware guarantee.
terms.body3: Trademarks and project names belong to their respective owners.
